entities.summary: Megalithic archaeological landscape in laos, consisting of thousands of stone jars scattered around the upland valleys and the lower foothills of the central plain of the xiangkhoang plateau. Plain of Jars is a archaeological site from Asia. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
